title: Throttle noisy API tenants
prompt: Implement `Throttle.allow(tenant, now)` in api/throttle.py: allow at most `limit` requests per tenant in any `window_s`-second window, and return False once a tenant is over the limit. It protects our public API from noisy tenants.
notes: Per-tenant isolation. A dict of deques. The lazy-wrong version keeps one shared counter, so one noisy tenant locks out everyone.
extension: Some tenants pay for more: add per-tenant limits that override the default.
